citation: Respondek F, Hilpipre C, Chauveau P et al. (2014). Digestive tolerance and postprandial glycaemic and insulinaemic responses after consumption of dairy desserts containing maltitol and fructo-oligosaccharides in adults. European Journal of Clinical Nutrition 68(5):575-580.
protocol: Six dairy desserts, crossover: control with 35 g dextrose (48.1 g carbohydrate, 36.0 g sugars) vs desserts in which sugar is replaced by maltitol and/or short-chain FOS (one at the same 48.1 g carbohydrate with 1.1 g sugars; others 25.9-41.6 g carbohydrate). Venous blood at -5, -1, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120 min.
population: n=36 healthy adults aged 18-60, BMI 18.5-30 kg/m2; glycaemic sub-study n=18.

note: Paired-meal contrast, sugars: dextrose dessert vs maltitol dessert at matched total carbohydrate (other arms also swap sugar for fibre). Sugar-content contrast at fixed carbohydrate grams, rare in this search. Watch: maltitol is a polyol counted in carbohydrate but not sugars, so check the reader maps it; FOS arms mix sugar and fibre; same group as the excluded lecerf-2015 but a different trial (DOI differs).
